verdict.rationale: Fireworks exposes an OpenAI-compatible REST API (chat completions, tool calling, structured outputs, embeddings, batch inference) documented extensively, with a live public endpoint confirmed by probe (api.fireworks.ai returning proper JSON auth errors) and a public status page. missing for 10: no publicly hosted OpenAPI/swagger spec was found (404s on standard paths), slightly reducing machine-readability of the API contract.
